friendly_name: Backfill habits JSONL from Felix comments
source_description: GitHub issue #307 (Phase 4 of ADR-0002). One-time backfill: read existing [Felix] comments from production habit tasks and replay as JSONL entries via Phase 2's state_log library so historical completion data is preserved before Phase 5 cutover (#308). Production data probe (2026-05-19) found only 26 total comments across the 8 originally-touched habit tasks, with 2 distinct state values (complete: 24, will-not-do: 2). Depends on #305 (state_log) + #306 (post-migration task state).
